title: Xunfei Spark X2.5 Officially Released: MoE Architecture with 293B Code and Intelligent Agent Capabilities Significantly Improved

content_html:
iFLYTEK officially released the Spark X2.5 large model. This model adopts a MoE architecture, with a parameter scale of 293B-A30B, focusing on improving code and agent capabilities, and continuously enhancing general capabilities such as mathematics and understanding.

Spark X2.5 was trained and inferred using fully domestic computing power throughout the entire process, and continues to optimize the challenges of domestic ultra-long sequence training and inference. It is now available on the iFLYTEK Open Platform.

The edge-side model has been released as open source first, supporting a context of up to one million Tokens

Previously, the edge-side models of Spark X2.5-4B and 1.7B have already been released as open source, supporting a maximum context of 1 million Tokens, which can be deployed locally for scenarios such as long document processing, code assistance, and data analysis. With the release of this X2.5 flagship model, iFLYTEK has completed the layout of new versions on both cloud and edge product lines.
